## Pandoscope

<!-- d10e: auto-prune -->

**Pandoscope** is the product that lets [agents](agent.md) build and
maintain software on their own. Its command line stamps a project's
repositories from the template, composes each session's instructions
from its role, and checks the orders that start review sessions.

_Avoid_: the framework
